title: Payments
subtitle: Record standalone payments and distribute amounts across open invoices

standalone.title: Standalone payment
standalone.helper: Use this path when the payment should be recorded directly without invoice distribution.

distribute.title: Distribute payment
distribute.helper: The amount is applied automatically across the customer's open approved invoices, starting with the oldest eligible balance.
distribute.customerOnly: Distribution is only available for customers because it applies directly to open sales invoices.

openInvoices.title: Open invoices
openInvoices.subtitle: Only approved invoices that are not fully paid are listed
openInvoices.emptyDescription: This customer has no approved unpaid invoices available for distribution right now.

messages.distributeSuccessDetailed: Payment distributed successfully. {amount} was applied across {count} invoice(s).

errors.invalidStandalonePayload: Select a customer and enter a valid amount before submitting standalone payment.
errors.invalidDistributePayload: Select a customer and enter a valid amount before distribution.

intent.distributionDescription: Start with the usual collection flow and let the system apply the amount across open invoices.
intent.standaloneDescription: Use this when you need to register a payment for a supplier, employee, or a one-off balance.
